title: Hayati Strawberry Lychee Nicotine Pouches
description: Hayati Strawberry Lychee nicotine pouches combines ripe Strawberry with aromatic Lychee for a softly sweet, rounded taste. Each slim pouch sits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. Available in 12mg (Strong), 20mg (X Strong) and 30mg (X Strong). Each can includes 20 pouches in a compact, pocket-friendly format. Created by Hayati, a UK brand specialising in vape and nicotine products, this pouch collection focuses on familiar flavours and straightforward strength choices. Explore more Hayati Nicotine Pouch flavours such as Rubyberry, Banana Ice and Blueberry. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users Extra Strong - 20mg to 30mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
